name: bestuurdersportaal-scanner
description: Geïsoleerde ClamAV-malwarescanner (Route A WP3). Eigen Vercel-project, geen langlevende credentials.

scripts.test:w0:prepare: node test/corpus/genereer.mjs && mkdir -p test/harness/certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 2 -subj /CN=abc123xyz.supabase.co -addext subjectAltName=DNS:abc123xyz.supabase.co -keyout test/harness/certs/sleutel.pem -out test/harness/certs/cert.pem
